_comment: Curated corrections to strategy pages that are out of date. Applied by generator/overrides.py after extraction, so the parser itself stays faithful to the wiki. Every rule must still match: when a page catches up, validation fails and the rule should be deleted rather than left to rot.

overrides.reason: The colossal pouch is made by stitching the small, medium, large and giant pouches together, which consumes them, so a player cannot carry both. It holds 40 essence in one inventory slot against 30 across four. The Abyss strategy page predates it and never mentions it; Guardians of the Rift lists both tiers.
